title: IPO GMP Tracker
description: Automatically tracks live IPO Grey Market Premium (GMP) data and sends a daily email alert whenever a mainboard IPO's GMP crosses 50% — from its open date to its close date.

title: Extension
description: An extension for salesforce commerce cloud developers to pretty print JSON text if any file in an IMPEX location contains JSON text.

title: Tomcare Website
description: A static website for Tomcare, a startup that provides car washing and servicing. The website is built using HTML, CSS and Javascript and is hosted on GitHub Pages.

title: Pedal Fiddle
description: Pedal Fiddle is a personal web app that hooks into Strava's webhook API to process new activities in near real-time. The moment you finish a ride, run, or workout, it generates an AI-crafted name and description, and applies your configurable privacy rules — all without you lifting a finger.

title: Syncing Ship
description: Syncing Ship automatically syncs your GPS-tracked exercises from Samsung Health to Strava in the background. Once configured, the app operates completely autonomously - no user interaction required!
